blind_llm_patch_proposal.diagnosed_failure: The Source program instance hard-codes absolute positions, so compilation ignores the current series' observer-localized nodes and edits unrelated locations when series length changes.
blind_llm_patch_proposal.falsification_condition: On a fresh series of a different length, the frozen compiler receives valid H0 node indices but executes any different position, omits an in-range localized node, or changes any position outside the localized node set.
blind_llm_patch_proposal.non_target_invariant: Observation logic, local-median repair semantics, scope policy, guards, Consumer, Metric, and outcome-access policy remain unchanged; neither Dataset ID nor Query outcome is used.
blind_llm_patch_proposal.predicted_behavior_change: For every compiled instance, executed_positions equals the in-range H0 localized node set; node_overlap becomes complete and no position outside that observed scope is modified, including for lengths 286 and 96.
blind_llm_patch_proposal.proposed_change: Compile each program instance by binding its replacement positions directly to the H0 observer's localized node set for the current visible-fit series, preserving the existing center-excluded local-median operation and all other surfaces.
